args.subject: Group booking inquiry - 10 people in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am interested in making a group stay at your hotel. I am writing to inquire about availability for 10 people in June.

Could you please provide information on room options, rates, and any group-specific amenities or requirements? I would appreciate details on the booking process and any necessary steps to secure a reservation for our group.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com

- Your name (Emma Johnson) and company (Blue Sparrow Tech)
